executionPolicy.commit: one focused commit per completed package
executionPolicy.impact: GitNexus upstream impact before every symbol edit; report HIGH/CRITICAL before editing
executionPolicy.changeReview: GitNexus detect_changes against main before every commit
executionPolicy.ui: Playwright or Chrome DevTools only after explicit user authorization
executionPolicy.container: Only when explicitly requested; npm run build first; never parallel test containers

packages.title: Ephemeral worker compaction through the existing Canvas engine
packages.gate: Ephemeral worker completes after two compaction cycles; summary watermarks follow persisted complete child messages; failed/aborted compaction leaves raw history intact.

packages.title: Safe reuse of managed worker sessions
packages.gate: Second task reuses one authorized session with its own active toolsets; cross-parent and concurrent reuse fail.
evidence: npx eslint on changed TypeScript files

packages.title: Durable checkpoints and authorized live inspection
packages.gate: Both worker types expose bounded current progress and confirmed transcript after reload without cross-session access.
evidence: npx eslint on changed application TypeScript files

packages.title: Bradley list, steer, stop and follow-up controls
packages.gate: Exactly one owned running worker receives a correction or stop; missed steering and terminal follow-up are explicit.
evidence: npx eslint on changed application and test TypeScript files

packages.title: Inline chat cards and worker detail view
packages.gate: Correct card identity, status and controls for concurrent and sequential tasks after reload; approved UI test passes.
evidence: npx eslint on changed application and test TypeScript files

packages.title: Integration verification and guarded rollout
packages.gate: All earlier gates, relevant regressions, lint, build and authorized UI verification pass without duplicate delivery or privilege expansion.
evidence: GitNexus impact before existing symbol edits; detect_changes before commit
